chunks: That is the Day of Decree/Sorting; We gathered you and the earlier (generations).

key_terms.الْأَوَّلِينَ: The earlier generations or peoples of the past.
key_terms.يَوْمُ الْفَصْلِ: The Day of Decree or Sorting, referring to the Day of Judgment when matters are decided.

ai.seo_question: What is meant by the Day of Fasl in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Adh-Dhariyat emphasizes the finality and absolute authority of God's judgment, where the 'Day of Decree' serves as the ultimate separation between truth and falsehood. It highlights the resurrection of all generations, reinforcing the concept of universal accountability before the Divine Court, a theme central to Shia eschatology regarding the eventual establishment of justice.
